name: opfs-async
description: Monorepo for opfs-lsm, a browser key-value store on OPFS and IndexedDB
author: Guido D'Orsi

scripts.static: pnpm lint && pnpm check:docs && pnpm deadcode
scripts.test: node scripts/check-readme.mjs && pnpm --filter './packages/*' run build && pnpm run '/^test:(suites|examples)$/'
scripts.test:suites: pnpm --filter @opfs-lsm/kv test:unit && pnpm --filter @opfs-lsm/docstore test && pnpm --filter @opfs-lsm/yjs test && pnpm --filter @opfs-lsm/automerge test && pnpm --filter @opfs-lsm/tanstack-db test && pnpm --filter @opfs-lsm/fate test && pnpm --filter @opfs-lsm/example-whiteboard-yjs test
scripts.test:docstore: pnpm --filter @opfs-lsm/kv run build && pnpm --filter @opfs-lsm/docstore run build && pnpm --filter @opfs-lsm/docstore test && pnpm --filter @opfs-lsm/yjs test && pnpm --filter @opfs-lsm/automerge test
scripts.todo:example: pnpm --filter @opfs-lsm/kv build && pnpm --filter @opfs-lsm/docstore build && pnpm --filter @opfs-lsm/example-todo dev
scripts.todo:example:build: pnpm --filter @opfs-lsm/kv build && pnpm --filter @opfs-lsm/docstore build && pnpm --filter @opfs-lsm/example-todo build && pnpm --filter @opfs-lsm/example-todo preview
